title: Pure-tensor section in a prescribed scalar-extension model
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site small in the coefficient universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], [def-weil-size-convention], with sheaf composition along the forgetful functor from commutative rings to rings, abelian sheafification, and equality of the sheafification-local equivalences with locally bijective maps. Let $a:R\to S$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings, and choose independently sized unbounded derived categories of their module sheaves. Let $F$ be a derived change-of-rings cochain model for $a$ [def-sfb-derived-change-of-rings-cochain-model], with ordinary extension $F.E$ and its prescribed object equality $F.E(M)=a^*M$. For an $R$-module sheaf $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], an object $U$ of $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}$, $s\in S(U)$ and $x\in M(U)$, define $\operatorname{scalarTensorSection}(F,M,U,s,x)\in (F.E(M))(U)$ to be the image of the pure tensor $s\otimes x\in S(U)\otimes_{R(U)}M(U)$ under the sheafification-unit map for the sectionwise change-of-rings presheaf, transported from $a^*M$ to $F.E(M)$ along the inverse of the prescribed object equality. This definition asserts no flatness, finite-freeness, completion hypothesis, or existence of a model.
